title: v0.34.0
description: v0.34.0 1,061 commits from 412 contributors (120 new). Thank you! TL;DR 10 new models (Mistral Large 4, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe, and more!) Extensible KV cache is on by default: vLLM sizes the KV cache from memory actually free after warmup, so most models get a bigger cache and more throughput. Model Runner V1 is gone. Model Runner V2 is now the only GPU runner. Big speedups on Blackwell and MI355X: up to 1.95× decode (Step5 on GB200), 1.6× throughput (GLM-5.3-Flash), 1.24–1
